acceptance: The run sheet opens with the prerequisites and the record sheet, and every step names who does it, the skill or tool, the file or sheet, the exact prompt or command, the expected result and a pass or fail box. (B01, B02)

The documented commands for the review export, the apply, the vendor and the summary steps, run from the sheet's own text on the fixtures, give the expected outputs, and every rerun changes nothing. (B03, B04, B07, B10)
The vendor round trip and the developer incorporation reach the expected master cells and a proposal that validates, with no duplicate question row. (B05, B06)
Failure handling is written for every step, including the stop on a failure and the fallback marking. (B08)
The fixtures are fictional, hold expected outputs for every step and no copy of the contract or schema, and the vendor workbook has no internal column. (B09, B10)
